Meyer Lemonade
By: Ronald Dorfman
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 12:48am

Ingredients




1/2 Meyer Lemon
Sugar or Sweetener 

Soda or Seltzer Water

Ice ( if you like)

Preparation

1 In an 8 oz glass .... 2 Sqeeze the Meyer Lemon thru a strainer (to remove the seeds) 3 Add 1/2 glass of Fizzy Water 4 Add Sweetner or Sugar to Taste -- 5 Perfect with more of any of the above.

About


This has a unique taste and is unusually quenching. I have not found any pre made drink that tastes like this.
Ripe Meyer Lemons are  easy to squeeze and yeild plenty of  juice.  The skin appears thin enough to make easy extraction.
